verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only per-item API operations: creating, listing, updating, removing or restoring individual payments. It also covers installment calculation within a single charge. No batch or bulk endpoint, and no mass-action capability across many items, is documented. API automation is a developer building block a user could loop over, not a bulk-operations capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
